sections.overview: The Ringed Carpet is a geometrid moth of open, scrubby landscapes.
sections.identification: British adults have a wingspan of about 28–35 mm.
sections.habitat: In Britain it favours heathland dotted with trees and bushes.
sections.diet: Its caterpillars feed on several plants, including birch and bog myrtle.
sections.behavior: Finnish records describe adults flying at dusk and at night, and coming to light.
sections.reproduction: The Finnish species account reports overwintering inside the pupa; further breeding details vary by source.
sections.ecology: Its larvae use both woody hosts and low plants, linking it to mixed heath vegetation.
sections.conservation: The references consulted describe its natural history but give no population trend or formal risk category.
